title: Complimentary Alteration Credit — Finch Circle Annual Amounts by Tier
content:
Members of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program at the upper tiers receive complimentary alteration credit for each calendar year the tier is held. The annual amount differs by tier; the carryover term and the items the credit can pay for are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Annual alteration credit (USD) | Unused credit carries into the next calendar year | Alterations the credit can pay for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 0.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |
| Finch Circle Silver | 0.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |
| Finch Circle Gold | 50.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 100.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 200.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |
| Finch Circle Icon | 300.00 | No | items purchased at Marlowe & Finch |

## Definitions

- **Annual alteration credit** — the complimentary alteration credit granted for each calendar year the tier is held, USD to 2 decimals.
- **Carryover** — whether unused alteration credit carries over into the next calendar year; at no tier does it.
- **Eligible items** — which alterations the credit can pay for: alterations to items purchased at Marlowe & Finch.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Diamond member's annual amount is 200.00; a Finch Circle Gold member's is 50.00.
- Finch Circle Member and Finch Circle Silver show 0.00.
